Definition: Organization that is funding the grant
Organization that is receiving funding from the grant
Human readable locally unique identifier for a grant. Typically this a concatenation of the activity code and contact PI for NIH grants. Example: U24 Hawrylycz grant
Long form title for a grant. Typically this is the project title from NIH grants.
Unique identifier for a grant resolvable by external authority. Typically this is the project number from NIH grants.
Resource location component in NIH RePorter URL. Symbol in RePorter URL that redirects to project details page in RePorter.
